sources.name: up_district_panel
sources.description: UP district panel join: nearest district centroid within 75 km, assets inside the UP bounding box only.

sources.name: nasa_power_point
sources.description: NASA POWER point API fetched at each asset's own coordinate; covers every asset with non-null coordinates.

join_rule.description: UP district source: each asset with non-null coordinates and verification_status != 'unverified' is joined to the nearest UP district centroid by haversine distance (mean Earth radius 6371.0088 km) ONLY IF the asset lies inside the Uttar Pradesh bounding box (latitude 23.5..31.0, longitude 77.0..85.0) AND the distance is <= 75 km. The NASA POWER point source is joined at the asset's own coordinate (distance 0) for every asset with non-null coordinates. UP rainfall is never joined to a non-UP asset.

sources.name: osm_highways
sources.description: OpenStreetMap highways (motorway/trunk/primary/secondary) fetched per asset tile (25 km buffer) from the Overpass API; national highways identified by ref tag (see NH_REF_RE in build_highway_features.py).

join_rule.description: Per asset with non-null coordinates: rd_dist_nh_m is the minimum geodesic distance to the nearest ref-tagged national-highway way in the asset tile; lengths are clipped to 10 km; node degree is the mean incident way-segment count over graph nodes within 10 km; corridor flag is true within 5 km of a corridors.yaml polyline. Assets with unverified coordinates receive no highway features.

sources.name: portwatch_ports
sources.description: IMF PortWatch global ports via HDX (2,065 rows, 37 for India); per asset the nearest India row with its vessel-call counts and trade shares (activity, not throughput).

sources.name: hdx_sea_ports
sources.source_name: HOT Sea Ports of India (via HDX)
sources.description: HOT Sea Ports of India (ODbL, 772 features); reference port polygons for the asset-inside-polygon test and port-boundary distances.

sources.name: natural_earth_coastline
sources.description: Natural Earth 1:10m coastline (public domain); geodesic distance to the nearest segment in the India window; coastal iff within 50 km.

join_rule.description: Per asset with non-null coordinates (linear assets use their sidecar midpoint coordinate): geodesic distance to the nearest reference port feature (42 reference points plus 60 HOT port polygons; zero when inside a polygon); count of reference features within 100 km; inside-polygon flag; geodesic distance to the Natural Earth coastline. Unverified-coordinate assets receive no maritime features. Throughput is gated (throughput_gated): no licenced programmatic source exists.

throughput.explanation: No licenced programmatic throughput (TEU) source exists: official IPA/Sagarmala tables are HTML/PDF-only and unreachable from this network. PortWatch vessel counts are activity, not throughput, and are never presented as such. mt_throughput_teu_yr is NULL on every row.
